an3.76:1.1: 77 athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.76:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhavo hotīti.
an3.76:2.1: kāmadhātuvepakkañca ānanda kammaṃ nābhavissa api nu kho kāmabhavo paññāyethāti.
an3.76:2.3: iti kho ānanda kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ taṇhā sineho
an3.76:2.4: avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ hīnāya dhātuyā viññāṇaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ evaṃ āyatiṃpunabbhavābhinibbatti hoti
an3.76:3.1: rūpadhātuvepakkañca ānanda kammaṃ nābhavissa api nu kho rūpabhavo paññāyethāti.
an3.76:3.3: iti kho ānanda kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ taṇhā sineho
an3.76:3.4: avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ majjhimāya dhātuyā viññāṇaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ evaṃ āyatiṃpunabbhavābhinibbatti hoti
an3.76:4.1: arūpadhātuvepakkañca ānanda kammaṃ nābhavissa api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethāti.
an3.76:4.3: iti kho ānanda kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ taṇhāsineho
an3.76:4.4: avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ paṇītāya dhātuyā viññāṇaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ evaṃ āyatiṃpunabbhavābhinibbatti hoti
